  • Apoiar análises de viabilidade técnica e de impacto dos projetos de inovação;
  • Contribuir para a construção de apresentações, relatórios e materiais executivos que traduzam resultados e aprendizados;
  • Monitorar tendências mercadológicas e tecnológicas e novos modelos de negócio em IA, dados, automação, IoT e sustentabilidade.
  • Transformar dados e aprendizados em insights acionáveis para decisões estratégicas.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação em Administração, Engenharia, Economia, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia em inovação, consultoria, estratégia ou corporate venture;
  • Participação em programas de parcerias com startups.
  • Mentalidade e postura consultiva e pensamento sistêmico;
  • Familiaridade com frameworks de inovação, metodologias ágeis e ferramentas de gestão de portfólio;
  • Curiosidade e repertório sobre tecnologias emergentes (IA, automação, dados, blockchain, etc.).
  • Conhecimento em uso e aplicação de IA para negócios;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de IA generativa (ChatGPT, Notion AI, Claude, Gemini etc.) aplicadas à produtividade e estratégia.
  • Visão de negócio, pensamento analítico e habilidade de comunicação executiva;
  • Capacidade de traduzir desafios complexos em soluções estratégicas e comunicá-los com clareza para públicos executivos.

Diferenciais:

description:

Pessoas proativas e inovadoras, capazes de identificar de forma contínua novas oportunidades e soluções para transformar algo bom em algo melhor;

title: Systems Engineer
description:
As THE leader in transit technology, Clever Devices' vision is to make meaningful contributions to worldwide mobility. Our goal is to be the leading provider of exciting technology that improves the quality of mobility in communities around the world.


This role will cover either our open B (4PM - 12PM) and C (12PM-8AM) shift as well as weekends.


Job Summary:

The Systems Engineer is responsible for leading the deployment of complete systems that include Clever Devices products combined with complementary technologies, including deployment of hardware products and interfaces, to provide a holistic solution that meets customer requirements.

The Systems Engineer works closely with the project team to analyze the customer requirements and required functionality early in the project cycle; create design documents, system architecture, requirement matrix and support the customer design reviews, conduct the Factory Acceptance Testing with the customer and lead the subsequent deployment at the Customer site. Execute and complete the System Acceptance Testing along with the customer and all other parties involved in the project

The Systems Engineer coordinates all system development and integration tasks to include design, integration and formal testing. The Systems Engineer also works to support the Systems Engineering team.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Supports the definition of software and hardware products and interfaces
  • Coordinates system development tasks to include design, integration and formal testing
  • Oversees all transitions into customer’s deployment
  • Develops and completes projects in system specifications, technical and logistical requirements and other disciplines
  • Creates and maintains programmatic and technical documentation (design docs, requirement matrix, system diagrams, etc) to insure efficient planning and execution
  • Manages and documents system configurations
  • Ensures the deployment of the solution is successful
  • Maintains a thorough working knowledge of enterprise applications such as BusTime and CleverCAD
  • Implements Performance analysis and reliability analysis of the end to end protocol

title: Data Scientist
description:
DYWIDAG stands as a global leader in construction and infrastructure technology that works with government authorities, asset owners, construction companies, and design offices to support their infrastructure projects. We have expanded into over 50 countries worldwide and continue to keep infrastructure safe and secure every single day.


Purpose of the Job

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Data Scientist to join our team. The ideal candidate will have 2–3 years of hands-on experience as a data scientist in a business environment, supporting multiple departments and functions with predictive analytics and rapid development of minimal viable products (MVPs). A strong emphasis is placed on experience with pricing engines and sales forecasting solutions. You will be responsible for analyzing large datasets, building predictive models, and enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Collect, clean, and preprocess structured and unstructured data from diverse sources.

  • Support various departments (e.g., Sales, Finance, Operations) with tailored predictive models and insights.
  • Visualize data insights using dashboards and reports, primarily with Power BI.
  • Clearly communicate findings and recommendations to stakeholders through presentations and documentation.
  • Continuously improve data quality, analytical processes, and model performance.
  • Stay current with the latest trends and technologies in data science, machine learning, and AI.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • 2–3 years of proven experience as a data scientist in a business setting, supporting multiple departments/functions.
  • Demonstrated expertise in developing predictive models for pricing engines and sales forecasting.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, or SQL.
  • Experience with data visualization tools, especially Power BI.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure cloud platforms is preferred.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with big data technologies (e.g., Azure Data Factory, Synapse, Spark, Hadoop).
  • Knowledge of deep learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch).
  • Industry experience in Construction is preferred; experience in Manufacturing or Engineering-related Big Data is also relevant.

title: Geotechnical Engineer
description:
We are seeking a skilled Geotechnical Engineer to lead quality assurance, compliance, and inspection efforts for civil infrastructure projects on Diego Garcia . This hands-on role focuses on geotechnical engineering practices—earthwork, excavation, backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation—ensuring strict adherence to US standards (USACE, EM 385-1-1), contractual obligations, and international codes (ISO, BS, EU). The Engineer will oversee testing, design, and maintenance of geotechnical elements in roads, bridges, and buildings.


Roles & Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement Project-Specific Quality Control Plans (QCP) in compliance with contract specifications, US Standards, and applicable international standards (e.g., ISO, USACE, EM 385-1-1), with a strong focus on geotechnical elements such as earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation.
  • Review design documents, technical specifications, and project plans to identify quality requirements, using computer-aided design (CAD) software and engineering principles to ensure civil/geotechnical infrastructure (e.g., roads, bridges, buildings) meets US Standards.
  • Perform daily inspections and surveillance of construction activities, including geotechnical assessments for earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, utility installation, concrete/steel testing, and site stability evaluations, to ensure compliance with approved plans, procedures, and project specifications.
  • Lead and Support the Three-Phase Control Process (Preparatory, Initial, and Follow-Up) and document all phases of work, with an emphasis on geotechnical risks, mitigations, and responsible charge oversight for earthwork and related activities.
  • Manage Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), implement corrective/preventive actions, and track resolution for issues related to geotechnical engineering, including excavation stability, backfilling compaction, pavement integrity, and utility installation.
  • Coordinate and supervise third-party testing laboratories, ensuring timely submittal and approval of test results for geotechnical materials (e.g., soil, aggregates) to BS, EU, and US Standards.
  • Oversee quality aspects of the construction, maintenance, and repair of civil infrastructure projects on Diego Garcia, with responsible charge for geotechnical components such as earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation, ensuring all work is performed in accordance with construction plans, specifications, and safety protocols.
  • Train and guide site personnel on quality standards, inspection protocols, documentation requirements, and geotechnical best practices, including safe handling of earthwork and utility-related tasks.
  • Maintain detailed QC documentation, including daily reports, inspection checklists, material submittals, test records, and CAD-generated plans for geotechnical-focused projects.
  • Interface with the client, project management, subcontractors, regulatory agencies, engineers, architects, and contractors on quality and geotechnical issues, providing technical support in a responsible charge role to ensure successful project completion.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of the quality system, recommend process improvements, and conduct/participate in internal audits while facilitating external quality audits as required.
  • Inspect civil infrastructure projects to ensure ongoing compliance with US Standards, project specifications, security, and safety procedures, including work in extreme weather conditions, with a focus on geotechnical stability and performance.


Qualifications & Requirements :

  • Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Licensed and registered as a Civil Engineer or Geotechnical Engineer in the United States of America (e.g., Professional Engineer (PE) certification).
  • At least 5 years of licensed experience, of which at least 3 years must be in responsible charge in geotechnical engineering practice or the type of work being performed on this project (e.g., earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation).
  • QC certification for relevant industries (e.g., geotechnical testing).
  • Significant material testing expertise to BS, EU, and US Standards.
  • Knowledge of US construction standards and codes (e.g., USACE, CQC).
  • Experience with government contracting, security, and safety procedures.
  • Hands-on experience in External & Internal Quality Audit Programmes, ISO Quality Management System, and quality tools/methodologies.

title: Especialista em  Automação e Software
description:
Sobre a Gruen


Fundada no Brasil em 2020, com sede em São Paulo, a Gruen conta com um time de engenharia atuando tanto localmente quanto na Alemanha o que assegura o desenvolvimento do processo mais eficiente para cada projeto. Nossa missão é entregar a melhor tecnologia para purificação de biogás com o menor consumo de energia entre todos os processos disponíveis no mercado.

Nossas soluções são específicas e feitas sob medida de acordo com a necessidade dos nossos clientes: pré-tratamento do gás, remoção de CO2 e N2, optional CO2 capture and storage ou liquefação, Liquefação de CH4 ou compressão de 250bar – desde o projeto inicial até a gestão da operação da planta, garantindo satisfação total de nossos clientes.

Fabricação e assistência técnica locais resultam em redução de custo e aumento de eficiência.

Soluções para contratos de manutenção e operação das plantas viabilizam a redução da complexidade e de custos.

Nossa motivação é desenvolver soluções viáveis na geração de energia limpa e sustentável para a preservação do nosso planeta e das gerações futuras.



Atribuições

  • Realizar projetos elétricos em plantas de energias renováveis (biogás).
  • Definir especificações técnicas do projeto.
  • Executar e supervisionar instalações internas e no cliente.
  • Definir sistemas de controle: arquitetura de rede, diagrama de interligação, lista de entradas e saídas, lista de materiais necessários para os projetos, memória de cálculo de dimensionamento de cargas e condutores.
  • Ser responsável pelo projeto elétrico completo de uma planta de biogás.
  • Auxiliar os técnicos elétricos com a montagem e/ou instalação em campo.
  • Criar e/ou adaptar software de projetos anteriores PLC e IHM (Siemens e Rockwell).
  • Realizar teste de equipamentos internamente e em fornecedores.
  • Identificar e realizar melhorias dos equipamentos.
  • Executar os startup e comissionamento dos equipamentos em conjunto com técnicos mecânicos, elétricos e outras pessoas envolvidas.
  • Ajustar e parametrizar diferentes equipamentos elétricos e eletrônicos.
  • Controlar interfaces e funcionamento de todos os módulos.
  • Realizar Interligações e controle de funcionamento em diferentes sistemas de comunicações, como: Profinet, Profibus, PA, As-Interface e outros.
  • Auxiliar o Gerente de Projeto na aprovação dos equipamentos nos fornecedores, bem como no sistema completo de purificação de biogás na planta do cliente.

Qualificações

  • Superior completo em Engenharia Elétrica, Automação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Possuir CREA ativo;
  • Conhecimento em Autocad, Eplan, programação Siemens e Rockwell.
  • Habilitação categoria B.
  • Perfil organizado, proativo, dinâmico, boa comunicação oral/escrita e com boa habilidade na resolução de conflitos.

Será visto como um diferencial:

  • Possuir certificação NR10, NR12, NR13, NR33 e NR35.
  • Possuir experiência/conhecimento com atmosfera explosivo.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens de 80-100% do tempo.

Benefícios

  • Regime de contrato CLT.

  • Vale transporte.
  • Vale refeição (Ticket Refeição).
  • Plano de saúde.
  • Plano Odontológico
  • Seguro de vida
  • Política de viagens vantajosa e desburocratizada

title: Gerente de Serviços Médicos

title: Bilingual Support Analyst (Portuguese & English)
description:

Requirements include sales and partners inquiries, post-sale related customer service inquiries, service/ repair and technical support requests, also troubleshooting technical issues as it relates to our products and services.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve customer issues through cases, phone calls, e-mails (and chat)
  • Handle (sales and) partners inquiries, post-sale related customer service inquiries, service/ repair and technical support requests, including troubleshooting technical issues
  • Salesforce Case Management
  • Network with internal business partners in order to investigate and resolve a customer’s issues
  • Perform user setups as it relates to Portal access

  • Provide remote support and update tickets within the customer Service Level Agreement
  • Provide technical escalation and reporting for incidents
  • Monitor issue resolution status and duration – own issues on behalf of the customer
  • Continuously acquire necessary product and service expertise

  • Help meet all operational goals: being willing to cross functional boundaries as and when required.

  • Languages: Fluent in both Portuguese and English (excellent spoken and written skills required for all languages).

  • Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Exceptional interpersonal skills with excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving: Strong observation, research, and analytical skills to effectively troubleshoot and resolve issues.

title: Gerente de logística
description:

Profissional com visão estratégica, capacidade de liderança e foco em resultados, apto a atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e com forte orientação para melhoria contínua.

title: Project Quality Engineer
description:
PROJECT QUALITY ENGINEER

Reports to: Quality Coordinator


Role Summary

- Assists with the interpretation of project-specific Quality Assurance requirements, verifies Quality Assurance plan implementation, and evaluates effectiveness by audits and assessments.

- Responsible for verification of design, procurement, manufacturing, site activities, tests, inclusion of appropriate inspections and their acceptance criteria into project documentation that will be deployed into the Supply Chain.

- Ensure that Quality is being incorporated into projects and processes (prevention), rather than inspected.


Key tasks of the Position

  • Reviews customers’ specifications, further legal / statutory requirements (Q related) and compare to industries standards aiming to identify main relationships and differences (if any), ensure proper requirements' management and compliance.
  • Reviews / issues project-specific Quality Plans and documentation (e.g.: Inspection & Test Plans, etc).
  • Supports, facilitates, reviews and releases project-specific Design & Process FMEAs, verification and validation reports, ensuring proper method application, risk analysis & classification, actions definition and their implementation.
  • Ensure project lessons learned (positive and negative) are produced and management system changes are implemented, as necessary.
  • Supports the development of project-specific sourcing & manufacturing strategies and schedules, ensuring that all relevant quality activities and requirements are considered and consistent to the strategies.
  • Participates on key project related meetings (e.g.: Design reviews) providing quality related input;
  • Ensure through process audits & verifications (e.g., at Engineering, Sourcing, Manufacturing, Field Services) and based on project-specific data analysis that quality is being incorporated in processes.
  • Drives, supports, and facilitates continuous improvement activities (e.g., at Engineering, Sourcing, Manufacturing, Field Services) based on project-specific data analysis.
  • Performs Technical Committee meetings prior components' release for shipping.
  • Supports, review and releases the Project-specific Quality Data book
  • Monitor the Project Quality Budget and to inform the Project Manager and the Project Quality Coordinator accordingly (eg compliance with Sales Forecast value; proceeding in case of deviations).


Additional responsabilities

  • Supports, on demand and based on his/her capabilities, Quality department's tasks & priorities defined by the Quality Engineering Coordinator & Head of Quality
  • Occasional Business Trips: ~ 20% of time


Decision-Making Powers

  • Full empowerment for rejection or blockage of processes and/or components when those are not compliant to the expected Quality requirements.
  • Power of tasks assignment (e.g.: start of a problem-solving activity) based on project-specific data analysis


EMPLOYEE PROFILE


Professional Experience & Education

  • Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Material, as applicable) or equivalent.
  • Postgraduate in Business Administration (desirable).
  • Relevant work experience in Quality Management & Quality Engineering.
  • Relevant professional experience and knowledge in business processes as well as in non-quality functions like Manufacturing, Logistics, Engineering, Purchasing.
  • Certified Lead Auditor (e.g. ISO 9001 and ISO 19011) (desirable).
  • Qualification in electrical and/or, dimensional and/or, NDT testing (desirable).


Specific Skills & Knowledge (Ex: Language, IT skills)

  • Practical knowledge in using IT-tools: SharePoint, SAP, MS Office, database tracking programs.
  • Good Lean Management background is an advantage.
  • Management and communication skills (incl. but not limited to interpersonal, listening, verbal, written, didactic and presentation).
  • English fluent, written and spoken (additional languages are an advantage).
  • Strong analytical expertise as well as result-oriented, solution driven (pragmatic) and customer oriented working principle.
  • Experienced and willingness to work and cooperate in cross functional teams

Descrição de Vaga: Engenheiro Estrutural – EFI Global


PROPÓSITO PRINCIPAL:

Atuar como engenheiro estrutural, com foco em avaliação de estruturas de concreto armado, estruturas metálicas, fundações e construções. O profissional deve ser capaz de realizar análises estruturais e cálculos de estruturas, incluindo pontes, torres, plataformas, tanques de água e edificações.   • Realizar análise estrutural de estruturas de concreto armado, metálicas, fundações, pontes, torres, plataformas e edificações para adição ou alteração de equipamentos diversos.

  • Apoiar os programas de qualidade da organização.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.


QUALIFICAÇÕES:

Formação & Licenças:

  • Graduação em Engenharia Civil ou Engenharia Estrutural por instituição reconhecida.
  • Mestrado em estruturas, especializações em pontes, rodovias e outras áreas correlatas são altamente desejados.


Experiência:

  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos em cálculos estruturais de concreto armado, estruturas metálicas, pontes, torres, etc.
  • Desejável experiência em análise de causa de incêndios, geologia, estruturas de fibra de vidro, carbono e madeira.
  • Experiência com AutoCAD e Mathcad obrigatória.


Habilidades & Conhecimentos:

  • Conhecimento e experiência com softwares como SAP2000, CYDE 3D, SLIDE2, AutoCAD.

  • Conhecimento em modelagem por elementos finitos.
  • Conhecimento das normas e regulamentos aplicáveis a projetos e desenvolvimento de sites.
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita.
  • Necessário possuir algum nível de inglês para leitura, escrita e comunicação técnica.
  • Domínio do pacote Microsoft Office.
  • Habilidades analíticas e interpretativas.
  • Forte organização e capacidade de trabalho em equipe.

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
We’re searching for a Salesforce Sales Cloud expert who also brings solid hands-on experience with Salesforce CPQ. In this role, you’ll architect and deliver solutions that simplify sales operations, improve quoting accuracy, and support a smoother customer journey. You’ll work across multiple teams to refine processes, automate routine tasks, and strengthen the overall sales technology ecosystem.


Primary Responsibilities

  • Serve as the lead consultant for designing, configuring, and rolling out enhancements across Sales Cloud and CPQ.
  • Work with business stakeholders to understand their goals and translate them into well-structured Salesforce solutions.
  • Configure core Sales Cloud components—including lead management, opportunity tracking, account and contact management, product and pricing setup, and the full quoting lifecycle.
  • Build and manage CPQ elements such as product bundles, pricing rules, discount logic, and end-to-end quote generation.
  • Create workflow automation through Flows, approvals, validation rules, and occasional Apex development.
  • Support integrations between Salesforce and other platforms such as ERP, billing, or marketing systems using APIs or middleware.
  • Oversee testing cycles, guide users through UAT, and deliver training to ensure smooth adoption.
  • Troubleshoot post-deployment issues and continually look for ways to improve system performance and usability.
  • Monitor Salesforce and CPQ updates to ensure the organization benefits from new features and best practices.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in technology, computer science, or a related field.
  • 5+ years working with Salesforce Sales Cloud in a configuration or implementation role.
  • At least 2 years of hands-on Salesforce CPQ experience.
  • Strong command of Sales Cloud data structures, platform capabilities, and standard functionality.
  • In-depth knowledge of CPQ configuration principles including product setup, pricing, discounting, and quoting mechanics.
  • Experience with Apex, Visualforce, LWCs, or integration tools (e.g., MuleSoft, Boomi) is a plus.
  • Salesforce Admin, Sales Cloud, and CPQ certifications are preferred.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to break down complex technical concepts for business users.

O Gerente de SHE é responsável pela implementação, otimização e gestão de processos da área de Segurança do Trabalho dentro de uma organização. Ele garante que a operação dos serviços seja eficientes, alinhadas com os objetivos estratégicos da área.

  • Atuar imediatamente qualquer atividade que apresente risco grave e iminente de acidente do trabalho ou doença ocupacional.

  • Monitorar os dados estatísticos de acidentes do trabalho, doenças profissionais e do trabalho, calcular a frequência e a gravidade.
  • Assegurar a gestão de equipe sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Promover a comunicação entre a Segurança e a gerência/diretoria dos sites.
  • Oferecer suporte ao negócio ao longo do ciclo de vida do projeto desde o planejamento, supervisão, monitoramento e documentação para assegurar a conformidade com os aspectos internos, externos e legais relacionados.

Scope : Senior executive officer responsible for the overall management and legal representation of the company in Brazil, ensuring full compliance with applicable laws and regulations, alignment with group strategy, and sound governance, risk and control frameworks. Acts as the company’s legal representative alongside other three directors before public authorities, regulators, financial institutions and key partners.


Key responsibilities : • Corporate management: lead the implementation of the business plan in Brazil, follow HQ priorities and ensure operational and financial targets are met. • Legal representation: act as the company’s legal representative before the Central Bank of Brazil and other regulators, tax authorities, courts, financial institutions, partners and suppliers, signing contracts, powers of attorney and corporate documents. • Regulatory relationship: maintain a constructive and transparent relationship with Brazilian regulators and self-regulatory bodies, including responding to inspections, official inquiries and information requests. • Financial stewardship: approve budgets according to HQ instructions, monitor cash flow, capital and liquidity needs, and ensure timely and accurate financial according to the finance team and regulatory reporting. • People and culture: build and lead the local leadership team, promote an ethical culture, and ensure adherence to the company’s code of conduct and policies, acting in a horizontal relationship alongside officers responsible for AML/CFT, Internal Controls & Compliance, and Risk, Capital & Disclosure.


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of professional experience, with solid background in financial services, payments, fintech and/or crypto, including prior experience in leadership or management roles;
  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian regulatory landscape applicable to the business (Central Bank of Brazil, COAF and, where relevant, CVM and other authorities).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Business Administration, Economics, Accounting, Finance, Engineering or a related field; a MBA or similar is a plus.
  • Proven leadership, stakeholder-management and decision-making skills, with a hands-on, ownership mindset.
  • Proficiency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must be resident in Brazil.
  • No disqualifying factors as described below:

I — not to be barred by special law, nor convicted of bankruptcy crimes, tax evasion, malfeasance, active or passive bribery, extortion, embezzlement, crimes against the popular economy, public faith, property, or the National Financial System, nor sentenced to a penalty that prohibits, even temporarily, access to public office;

II — not to have been declared disqualified or suspended from serving in statutory or contractual bodies at institutions authorized to operate by the Central Bank of Brazil or at pension entities, insurance companies, capitalization companies, publicly held companies, or entities subject to the supervision of the Securities and Exchange Commission of Brazil (CVM);

III — not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;

IV — unblemished reputation;

V — knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;

VI — technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: PM/PO Sênior
description:
Sobre a Consorciei

Somos a fintech líder no mercado de consórcios e estamos transformando a indústria com tecnologia e capital.


Desenvolvemos plataformas whitelabel e soluções com IA generativa que trazem eficiência às administradoras e uma experiência digital completa para os clientes — do momento da compra até o pós-venda.


⚙️Sobre o produto:

Estamos lançando um novo produto de cobrança com IA generativa para recuperação de clientes do consórcio, elevando a taxa de recuperação, eficiência operacional e experiência do cliente.


  • Plataforma de cobrança conversacional com IA generativa para contato ativo e passivo e negociação com clientes em atraso (1–3 parcelas);
  • Integração com as bases das administradoras para ingestão de carteiras, aplicação de regras de negociação e atualização de status;
  • Emissão/captura de boleto e código Pix, envio ao cliente, conciliação e atualização automática de pagamento;
  • Orquestração multicanal (por exemplo: WhatsApp, SMS, e-mail; futuramente voz) e acompanhamento de promessas de pagamento;
  • Painéis de performance, experimentação (A/B) e régua de cobrança configurável.



Missão do cargo:

Liderar a evolução e o sucesso do produto de cobrança com IA da Consorciei, desde discovery até scale-up, garantindo adoção pelas administradoras, performance de recuperação e experiência superior para clientes finais.


Como será o seu dia a dia:

  • Definir visão do produto, objetivos trimestrais e roadmap orientado a resultados de negócio (recovery rate, conversão, tempo de recebimento);
  • Conduzir entrevistas e acompanhamentos com administradoras e clientes finais, mapear jornadas, desenhar régua de cobrança e experiências conversacionais seguras e eficazes;
  • Priorizar backlog, escrever user stories/critérios de aceite, acompanhar o desenvolvimento com Tecnologia/IA/Design e garantir qualidade (UAT e go-live);
  • Definir KPIs, instrumentar analytics, criar e analisar experimentos, identificar alavancas de conversão e oportunidades de melhoria contínua;
  • Coordenar integrações com sistemas das administradoras, provedores de mensagens (CPaaS), meios de pagamento e conciliação;
  • Realizar demonstrações para administradoras, apoiar propostas, POCs e pilotos;
  • Liderar implantação, parametrização de regras de negociação/régua, monitorar resultados, criar playbooks e suportar equipes das administradoras;
  • Comunicar progresso, riscos e decisões; promover alinhamento e transparência;
  • Estabelecer SLAs, métricas de confiabilidade, gestão de incidentes e documentação do produto.



Requisitos obrigatórios pra vaga:

  • PO/PM em produtos digitais, preferencialmente fintech, bancos, meios de pagamento ou crédito;
  • Vivência em produtos B2B ou B2B2C, com integrações via APIs e implantação em clientes enterprise;
  • Forte domínio de métricas de produto e de funil de cobrança (contato, engajamento, promessa, pagamento, recuperação);
  • Experiência com discovery, priorização por impacto, escrita de user stories e condução de squads ágeis (Scrum/Kanban);
  • Conforto com dados: definir KPIs, analisar e gerar relatórios;
  • Excelente comunicação e escrita;
  • Inglês(básico/intermediário) para leitura técnica;


✨Diferenciais:

  • Experiência direta em cobrança/recuperação de crédito (régua de cobrança, negociação);
  • Vivência com administradoras de consórcios ou produtos para esse segmento;
  • Experiência com produtos de IA generativa/conversacional (LLMs, prompt design, guardrails, avaliação);
  • Conhecimento de WhatsApp Business API, provedores CPaaS (ex.: Zenvia, Twilio), CRMs e contact center;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas como Looker/Power BI/Metabase e Jira.



Pra nossas pessoas

A gente acredita que cuidar de quem faz a Consorciei acontecer é o que impulsiona o nosso crescimento.


Modelo de trabalho:

Estamos no modelo hibrido, 3x por semana no escritório! próximo da estação Fradique Coutinho/Faria Lima.


Benefícios que fazem parte da nossa jornada:

  • VR/VA flexível via iFood + Clube iFood gratuito;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico Bradesco, com ampla cobertura e possibilidade de incluir dependentes;
  • TotalPass — acesso a academias em todo o Brasil;
  • Stock Options — cresça junto com a Consorciei;
  • Seguro de vida e assistência viagem Bradesco;
  • Telemedicina e orientação médica 24h no app do Bradesco saúde;


Pra apoiar seu desenvolvimento:

  • Parceria com o Senac para impulsionar sua evolução profissional;
  • Avaliação de desempenho semestral, com foco em desenvolver a sua carreira;


Pra equilibrar vida e trabalho:

  • Horário flexível e modelo de trabalho que valoriza autonomia;
  • Convênio com o Sesc, para aproveitar cultura, lazer e bem-estar com sua família;
  • Licença parental estendida, 6 meses para mães e 20 dias para pais;


Se esse desafio é a sua cara, queremos te conhecer! Vem pro universo Consorciei

title: Data Governance Lead (Wholesale Banking)
description:
Data Governance Lead (Hybrid – São Paulo)

Job Description

Senior professional with solid experience in Data Governance, integration of data environments across regions or corporate units, risk management, and regulatory compliance in a wholesale banking context (MiFID, DISA, etc.). Able to lead the corporate data governance framework, drive a data-driven culture, and ensure consistency across data, processes, and platforms.


Join NFQ!

We are a global consulting firm specialized in business, technology, and operations, with over 2,000 professionals across national and international offices. At NFQ, we offer a different consulting model: Flexible | Scalable | Specialized | Client-Centric .

As part of our continuous growth, we are looking for a highly experienced Data Governance Lead to join our team in São Paulo (Hybrid model). This role is ideal for professionals who combine deep expertise in data governance, regulatory alignment, enterprise data frameworks, and cross-regional platform integration within a wholesale banking environment .


Key Responsibilities – Daily Activities

  • Lead the Data Governance framework for wholesale banking, ensuring alignment with corporate policies and both local and global regulatory expectations.
  • Coordinate the integration between local and global data platforms, ensuring standardization of metadata, ontologies, glossaries, lineage and corporate data models.
  • Oversee the controlled evolution of data environments (lakes, hubs, local tools, and global platforms), preventing fragmentation and ensuring end-to-end governance.
  • Drive data and AI literacy programs, designing training, communication, and best-practice adoption initiatives across business and technology areas.
  • Participate in the creation and operation of the Data Governance Body, including: definition of roles (Data Owner, Steward, Custodian, SPOCs), establishment of forums (Data Council, Data Quality Forum, Steward Community), annual agenda for maturity, compliance, and continuous improvement
  • Monitor governance KPIs such as quality, completeness, lineage, cataloging, control adherence, and maturity evolution.
  • Support business, risk, finance, and technology areas on Data Quality, Privacy by Design, access standards, security, and critical data management.
  • Act as the point of contact between local and global teams, ensuring alignment of roadmaps, reference models, and delivery milestones.


Must Have – Required Qualifications

Experience & Technical Knowledge

  • 3+ years of experience in Data Governance, Data Management, Data Strategy, or Data Governance Audit, preferably in banks, wholesale banking, financial services, or large consulting firms.
  • Strong mastery of DAMA-DMBOK pillars:
  • Data Quality
  • Metadata / Glossary
  • Data Lineage
  • Master & Reference Data
  • Data Architecture
  • Data Security & Privacy
  • Experience with data catalog and governance platforms (Collibra, EDC, Alation, Purview).
  • Solid knowledge of modern data architectures: lakehouse, data lake, ETL/ELT, APIs, streaming, data mesh.
  • Experience integrating or supporting the integration of data platforms across geographies (e.g., Databricks, Starburst).
  • Strong stakeholder-management capabilities, including senior leadership engagement.
  • Experience conducting workshops, training sessions, and data culture programs.


Nice to Have – Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Treasury, Markets, Risk, Corporate Banking or Wholesale Banking.
  • Experience with global governance platforms (Collibra Global, Data Hubs, DQ Engines).
  • Knowledge of data protection and security regulations (LGPD, GDPR, BACEN).
  • Certifications:
  • CDMP – DAMA
  • Data catalog tool certifications
  • Cloud (AWS / GCP / Azure)
  • Scrum / Kanban / Trello / Teams Planner
  • Understanding or experience with Data Mesh.
  • Experience with ESG data governance or operational risk.


What We Offer

  • Work in a dynamic, international environment with global mobility opportunities.
  • Continuous learning and official certifications.
  • Language classes to support your global career.
  • Personalized career development, mentorship, and performance-based growth.


CLT Contract Benefits:

  • Health & dental insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Meal voucher
  • Transportation allowance
  • Flexible work environment, wellness programs, internal events, and more.


Location: São Paulo, Brazil (Hybrid)

Em nossa Cultura, temos 3 pilares que nos orientam e direcionam: Gerar valor ao cliente, Fazer o certo do jeito certo e Sinceridade com Respeito.


Atuamos em mais de 15 categorias, temos 3 fábricas no Brasil e um laboratório na China, além dos escritórios em São Paulo e Belo Horizonte. São mais de 5 mil itens em portfólio, presentes em mais de 40 mil pontos de venda e em mais de 30 marketplaces parceiros.

title: Testing & commissioning Engineer
description:

The ideal candidate will ensure that all equipment and systems adhere to Industry standards and regulatory requirements through thorough and safe testing processes. Responsibilities will encompass managing all aspects of testing, including Factory acceptance Tests (FAT), Site acceptance Tests (Sat), and Integrated Systems Tests (IST). The engineer should be proficient in developing and executing test plans That align with customer needs while maintaining clear communication with the factory.

  • Preparing project documentation, including test reports, commissioning plans, and equipment manuals;
  • Participate in project meetings and effectively communicate with stakeholders to achieve project goals.

title: Risk Management Manager
description:
As the Safety Risk Manager, you will play a pivotal role in building the future of safety risk

management at Keeta.


Job Responsibilities:


  • Lead data analysis and modeling for platform risk scenarios
  • Conduct risk identification, classification, and early-warning analysis across rider/driver/courier, merchant, and customer segments.
  • Perform bottom-up data discovery and metric construction
  • Conduct in-depth EDA using raw mobility/delivery platform data (orders, location traces, incentives, behavioral logs).
  • Build standardized risk metrics, operational metrics, behavior features, and monitoring indicators from the ground up.
  • Apply top-down business perspective to drive strategy and execution
  • Work closely with product, operations, policy, and risk teams to translate high-level business goals into measurable and actionable metrics.
  • Drive 0→1 metric system design for new markets or new products, and evolve metrics for rapid growth and later-stage refinement.
  • Develop dashboards and risk monitoring systems
  • Build and maintain BI dashboards to monitor key risk, quality, safety, and operational metrics.
  • Detect anomalies, conduct root-cause analysis, and support incident response and post-mortem reviews.
  • Support cross-functional decision making and risk strategy design
  • Provide data-driven insights to support risk mitigation strategies, counter-measure design, operational policy updates, and business optimization.
  • Evaluate the impact of policy or product changes, and create closed-loop measurement frameworks.


Job Requirements:


  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Operations Research, Data Science, or related fields.


Technical Skills


  • Proficient in SQL and Python/R for data processing, modeling, and analysis.
  • Solid knowledge of machine learning methods (logistic regression, decision trees, anomaly detection, clustering) is preferred.
  • Strong ability to understand raw data structures and build robust metric definitions.
  • Risk Experience (Core Requirement)
  • Experience in risk analytics, trust & safety, fraud detection, operational risk, or platform governance—preferably in mobility, delivery, or other two-sided marketplace industries.
  • Familiar with risk assessment lifecycle: identification → quantification → monitoring → mitigation.
  • Bottom-Up Analytical Capability
  • Ability to investigate raw data (orders, trajectory data, incentives, cancellations, GPS signals, courier/driver behavior) and derive structured metrics and actionable insights.
  • Top-Down Business and Strategy Thinking
  • Ability to understand business models such as supply-demand balancing, delivery SLA, driver/courier incentives, merchant performance, and safety/quality frameworks.
  • Proven experience in designing and scaling 0→1→N metric systems supporting business objectives.
  • Project Experience (strong preferred but not necessary)
  • Experience supporting new market entry, new product launches, or rapid-scale operations is highly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently drive cross-functional initiatives to completion.


Soft Skills


  • Strong analytical reasoning, structured communication, and data storytelling abilities.
  • Ability to convert complex analysis into clear, practical recommendations for business stakeholders.
  • Proactive, ownership-driven mindset with high attention to detail.

Somos a Seguros Unimed, a Seguradora do Sistema Unimed, uma empresa criada por médicos e que tem o cooperativismo na essência. Cuidamos das instituições e das pessoas, para que possam viver bem o presente e planejar o futuro com segurança. Trabalhamos todos os dias para oferecer soluções completas, que potencializem novos negócios. E estamos ao lado dos nossos clientes na hora em que mais precisam. Acreditamos que a cooperação nos conecta para crescermos juntos.

Pelo 7º ano consecutivo, a Seguros Unimed integra o ranking dos Lugares Mais Incríveis para Trabalhar 2025, da FIA e do Estadão. E este ano, alcançamos o patamar MÁXIMO: somos O MAIS INCRÍVEL!

Siga nossa página aqui no LinkedIn e fique por dentro de nossas oportunidades de carreira.

Venha fazer parte da Seguros Unimed e ter uma Jornada Incrível conosco!


O que oferecemos nessa Jornada:

  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação;
  • Vale transporte ou estacionamento conveniado;
  • Seguro Saúde;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de Vida e Acidentes Pessoais;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Garantia Funeral;
  • Convênio com farmácia;
  • Gympass e Totalpass;
  • Happy Day - um dia de folga no aniversário.


Além disso, você encontra por aqui:

  • Trilha de desenvolvimento;
  • Plataforma exclusiva com treinamentos;
  • Programa de Desenvolvimento Profissional;
  • Ambiente de Trabalho Inovador;
  • Oportunidades de Crescimento na Organização;
  • Diversas parcerias e descontos pela região.



No seu dia-a-dia:

  • Realizar processos de geração de informações gerenciais, emitindo relatórios mensais de controle (Cotações, orçamento, produtividade, custos)
  • Elaborar, desenvolver e analisar indicadores operacionais e estratégicos, identificando e explicando suas variações.
  • Validar dados, gerar relatórios e informações do Seguro Saúde para clientes internos e externos.
  • Suportar os gestores das áreas no acompanhamento dos orçamentos, participando de reuniões para checagem e ajustes.

  • Preparar informações e análises de prestadores (EC, Canais, etc.), gerando relatórios para tomada de decisão.
  • Realizar a manutenção e atualização de Cronogramas e auxiliar no planejamento dos Planos de Metas.


Esperamos de você:

  • Formação Superior em Administração de Empresas, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência em atividades correlatas.
  • Vivência na criação, análise e manutenção de indicadores e relatórios gerenciais.
  • Habilidade em modelagem e construção de sistemas de informações.
  • Conhecimento em gestão e acompanhamento de orçamento, com análise de custos e desvios.
  • Domínio de Power B.I, Excel (tabela dinâmica, fórmulas) e PowerPoint para elaboração de relatórios e apresentações.
  • Capacidade analítica para validação de dados e investigação de desvios (ex: Seguro Saúde).


Informações adicionais:

  • Vaga extensiva a Pessoas com Deficiência - PCD;
  • Tipo de contrato: CLT;
  • Local de trabalho: São Paulo - SP
  • Todos os nossos processos seletivos são totalmente on-line nas etapas iniciais.


A Seguros Unimed respeita a pluralidade de identidades e trabalha para promover uma cultura inclusiva. Não fazemos distinção de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo, reforçando nosso compromisso de uma empresa focada em cooperar e no seu cliente interno e externo.

title: HR Operations Manager
description:
What You'll Do

We seek an experienced HR Operations Manager to drive HR policy development, SOP creation, process optimization, and team enablement. This role ensures standardized, well-implemented HR policies and processes support business goals and compliance.


HR Policy Enablement & Governance:

  • Develop, implement, and maintain comprehensive HR operations policies and SOPs that align with business goals and compliance requirements.
  • Ensure HR policies are consistently applied across all business units.
  • Regularly review work with relevant department and update HR policies to reflect changes in employment laws and best practices.

HR Process Standardization & Optimization:

  • Design, document, and continuously improve HR processes to enhance efficiency and compliance.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure HR processes are well-integrated and operationally sound.
  • Establish clear workflows and guidelines for employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, offboarding, probation and internal mobility, etc..

Quality Controal & Employee Experience

  • Ensure seamless execution of HR policies to improve employee experience and operational efficiency.
  • Provide training and communication on policy updates and process changes to HR teams and managers.
  • Conduct periodic audits to verify adherence to HR policies and recommend corrective actions where needed.
  • Implement a quality audit framework to regularly assess HR operations, identify gaps, and drive continuous improvements.


What We Need From You

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; Master’s degree is a plus.
  • 5+ years of experience in HR operations, policy management, or process governance within an international organization.
  • Strong knowledge of HR policy frameworks, compliance, and global employment regulations.
  • Experience in developing and implementing HR SOPs and process documentation.
  • Proficiency in HR technology solutions and data-driven decision-making.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.


What Make This Role Exciting

  • Be a driver in creating HR policies in a rapidly growing global company.
  • Influence decision-making by implementing scalable HR frameworks that will define future operations.
  • Work with cross-functional teams across multiple geographies to develop global HR policies while ensuring local compliance.
  • Gain hands-on experience navigating the complexities of international HR operations in a fast-scaling business.
  • Drive a culture of continuous improvement and quality audits to enhance HR service delivery.

title: Analista de Negócios (SAP/Hybris)
description:
Analista de Negócios (SAP/Hybris)


O Analista de Negócios fará parte da equipe global de entrega para facilitar a implementação do SAP/Hybris, com o objetivo de aprimorar a funcionalidade e o desempenho dos clientes.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Realizar análises de negócios e gerar insights para melhorar a eficiência operacional, incluindo suporte à documentação de business case, otimização de processos e aumento de produtividade/receita.
  • Trabalhar com unidades operacionais de negócios para aprimorar a tomada de decisão por meio de análises orientadas a dados, identificando necessidades operacionais e comunicando tendências/problemas.
  • Desenvolver e aprimorar técnicas de relatórios para melhorar a análise e os relatórios em nível corporativo.
  • Facilitar a implementação do SAP/Hybris para melhorar a funcionalidade e o desempenho dos clientes, incluindo análise de negócios e soluções alternativas.
  • Fornecer expertise em SAP Hybris Commerce, cockpits administrativos e aceleradores, incluindo mapeamento de requisitos de negócios e consultoria em tópicos de Omnichannel.
  • Compreender as estruturas de dados do SAP Hybris e facilitar discussões sobre modelos de dados, antecipando implicações de negócios.
  • Conduzir entrevistas para coletar casos de uso/requisitos funcionais e elaborar documentação.
  • Desenvolver requisitos de usuários, especificações funcionais/técnicas, modelos de dados e diagramas de fluxo de processos.
  • Atuar como especialista em cockpits administrativos do Hybris e aceleradores B2B/B2C.
  • Concluir o trabalho atribuído dentro dos prazos e comunicar o status caso haja risco de atraso nas entregas.
  • Configurar e gerenciar espaços de colaboração de projetos (Confluence) e sistemas de gestão de tarefas/issues (Jira).
  • Realizar importações de dados de catálogos de produtos em sistemas de eCommerce (dependente do projeto).
  • Fornecer demonstrações e treinamentos de sistemas de eCommerce para clientes.
  • Revisar análises pré-existentes para melhorar KPIs.
  • Desenvolver planos de teste, escrever scripts de teste e definir critérios de aceitação.


Experiência

  1. 2–3 anos de experiência total, com participação em pelo menos 3 projetos de implementação Hybris.
  2. 1–2 anos de experiência na implementação do Hybris Commerce.
  3. Compreensão sólida do SAP Hybris Application Lifecycle Framework.
  4. Experiência em consultoria de gestão nas áreas de estratégia de negócios/TI, governança, gestão de valor, gestão de processos e Centro de Excelência.
  5. Experiência prévia em análise de negócios/sistemas ou garantia de qualidade.
  6. Experiência comprovada em elicitação de requisitos e testes.
  7. Experiência em análise de dados para gerar conclusões relevantes para o negócio e utilização de técnicas/ferramentas de visualização de dados.
  8. Fortes habilidades de comunicação escrita e verbal, incluindo redação técnica.
  9. Inglês avançado para conversação.


Se você quer fazer parte de um time inovador e contribuir para projetos desafiadores, vem com a gente!

title: Senior Business Analyst - Incentive Planning
description:
About Keeta

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan , a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.” Guided by this principle, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage. With over 1,000 team members around the world, Keeta is in full expansion — and you could be part of this journey!


What You'll Do

  1. Performance Incentive Design: Develop rational sales performance frameworks aligned with business development stages and supply strategy, to drive strategy implementation and goal achievement.
  2. Execution & Continuous Improvement: Lead end-to-end implementation of performance plans: plan communication, progress tracking, settlement calculations, and result reviews. Collaborate with sales teams to evaluate execution effectiveness, identify gaps, and iteratively refine sales strategies to ensure solution viability.
  3. System & Process Optimization: Optimize performance management systems and processes, and partner with the product team to build tools that enhance efficiency.

What We Need From You

  1. experience in business analysis or data analysis is preferred, with experience in performance evaluation, target design, or sales strategy preferred.
  2. High business sensitivity, proficient in using SQL, Excel, skilled at identifying problems from data and proposing solutions.
  3. Strong communication and teamwork skills, able to effectively coordinate resources across departments.
  4. Strong work planning skills, meticulous, and highly responsible for deliverables.


What Makes This Role Exciting

  1. Target performance is one of the key levers to drive the sales team to achieve the company's overall goals, with strong implementation feasibility.
  2. Deep involvement in all aspects of business target and supply strategy formulation, close to business operations.
  3. Opportunity to deeply understand the operational mechanisms of the food delivery business, collaborate across functions, and achieve significant personal growth.


4. Job Highlights

Join us to witness the rapid growth of Meituan's global food delivery business and experience firsthand the industry transformation and growth miracles. You will collaborate with a world-class, diverse team, fostering innovative thinking, expanding your international perspective, and deepening your expertise. This is not just a job—it's an unparalleled opportunity to achieve personal growth, realize your self-worth, and drive global business innovation.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Job Title: DevOps Engineer

Duration: 12 months (ASAP Start)

Work Type: Hybrid (3 Days Onsite per Week)

Location: São Paulo, Brazil )


Position Overview:

We are seeking an experienced DevOps Engineer to design, implement, and maintain scalable, secure, and efficient DevOps solutions in Azure. The ideal candidate will have deep hands-on experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) , CI/CD pipelines , and infrastructure automation , with a strong background in cloud architecture and system reliability.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align DevOps practices with business goals.
  • Support incident , problem , and change management processes.
  • Architect, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for retail applications.
  • Deploy and manage containerized workloads using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and Kubernetes.
  • Manage and optimize Azure infrastructure , ensuring performance, scalability, and cost-efficiency.
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform , ARM templates , and scripting tools (PowerShell , Bash , Python ).
  • Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting with Azure Monitor , Grafana , and related tools.
  • Support day-to-day DevOps operations and contribute to environment stability.
  • Develop and maintain scripts for automation and system optimization.
  • Ensure digital security, perform vulnerability management, and participate in disaster recovery planning and testing .
  • Troubleshoot networking, infrastructure, and deployment issues.


Essential Skills & Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in technology with a strong focus on DevOps and cloud engineering .
  • Deep expertise in Microsoft Azure , including virtual machines, AKS, networking, storage, load balancers, and security.
  • Strong understanding of containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Hands-on experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab).
  • Proficient in infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform, ARM templates, or similar tools.
  • Solid programming experience in one or more languages: C#, Java, or Python .
  • Strong SQL and database experience (MS SQL Server, SSIS, SSRS, SSAS).
  • Skilled in scripting (PowerShell , Bash ) and automation frameworks.
  • Experience applying modern Service Delivery methods — Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and ITIL-based processes.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with proven ability to work across teams.
  • Knowledge of cloud security best practices , including IAM, firewalls, and network security groups.


Desired Qualifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure DevOps Engineer Expert — validating expertise in designing and implementing DevOps practices on Azure.
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert — demonstrating advanced Azure solution design skills.
  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) — validating Kubernetes deployment and management proficiency
  • Experience with retail or wholesale trading systems is a plus.

title: ANALISTA RELAÇÕES COM INVESTIDORES SR.
description:
A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Suas atividades englobam a concepção, o planejamento, o desenvolvimento e a administração de shopping centers regionais, outlets e complexos imobiliários de uso misto com torres comerciais. A Iguatemi detém participação em 15 shopping centers, 2 Premium Outlets e 4 torres comerciais. As ações da Iguatemi estão listadas no Novo Mercado da B3 (IGTI11) e fazem parte do índice Ibovespa. Nossa missão é criar experiências únicas e memoráveis a todos os nossos clientes.


Qual será sua missão?


  • Tem como responsabilidades o atendimento às exigências dos órgãos regulamentadores do Mercado de Capitais no Brasil, preparação de relatórios trimestrais com o resultado da Companhia, manutenção e atualização do site de Relações com Investidores da Companhia, atendimento aos analistas buy side e sell side, bem como atendimento aos investidores e potenciais investidores da Companhia;
  • É responsável pela preparação dos materiais que a Companhia divulga para o Mercado Financeiro e pela conferência das informações que são divulgadas para a imprensa;
  • Acompanhar, monitorar e entender os números e indicadores das empresas concorrentes e a preparação de apresentações institucionais para o público interno e externo, além de apresentações de resultados para o mercado financeiro e para o Conselho de Administração e Conselho Fiscal da Companhia;
  • Preparação e envio de informações para advogados, bancos e órgãos regulamentadores em caso de ofertas públicas de ações ou dívida e controle e monitoramento da base acionária da Companhia;
  • Conhecer as regras de mercado de capitais, melhores práticas de governança, além de conhecimentos financeiros e do setor de atuação da Companhia.


Responsabilidades:


  • Preparar e enviar informações para os órgãos reguladores do Mercado de Capitais Brasileiro: Inclui a preparação de Formulário de Referência, preparação e envio de informações financeiras, comunicados ao mercado e fatos relevantes e preparação de Formulário Cadastral;
  • Analisar dos indicadores operacionais e financeiros da Companhia para preparação de release de resultados, além de mensagem da administração;
  • Preparar apresentação de resultados para os calls de resultados conduzidos pelo Presidente e CFO; Preparação de apresentação para aprovação dos resultados nos Conselhos de Administração e Fiscal;
  • Preparação de apresentações institucionais para reuniões com analistas sell side e buy side e investidores;
  • Realizar apresentação institucional da companhia para analistas de bancos, corretoras e assets, bem como investidores e potenciais investidores;
  • Conduzir reuniões e responder as dúvidas dos investidores e analistas, bem como fornecer as informações financeiras e a participação em conferências e feita junto com os superiores;
  • Assegurar que todas as informações divulgadas ao mercado estão no site e estão atualizadas;
  • Acompanhar os resultados e conhecer as estratégias e principais números dos concorrentes para poder conversar com analistas de mercado e preparar relatórios internos para diretoria e
  • Responsável pela preparação de comunicados ao mercado (financeiros, novos negócios ou comunicados de marketing), fatos relevantes e conferência dos números e informações que as diversas áreas da Companhia passam para o mercado em geral;
  • Preparação dos documentos que precisam ser enviados aos bancos, advogados e órgãos regulamentadores;
  • Acompanhamento e monitoramento da base acionária.


Modelo de trabalho: 100% presencial.

Requisito: Inglês Avançado.

title: Associate Sales Representative Bilingual (PORT+ENG)
description:

This role is responsible for effectively articulating the value of products or services to customers.



The role involves expertise in identifying potential customers and converting them into clients, focusing on the dynamic and rapidly evolving social media and technology sectors in Brazil. You will play a crucial part in expanding Meta's market presence in this vibrant region by understanding local customer behavior and preferences



You will

  • Conduct detailed market assessments to identify potential client segments and tailor acquisition strategies relevant to the Brazilian context.
  • Develop and implement culturally and contextually adapt marketing and outreach strategies in alignment with Meta's branding.
  • Engage with potential clients via various communication platforms including face-to-face meetings, social media platforms, and digital communications to build strong relationships.
  • Collaborate with internal marketing and sales teams to localize content suitable for the Brazilian market.

  • Availability to commute to the office: Chacará Santo Antonio (Zona Sul).

title: Senior Facilities Manager
description:
Primary Purpose of the Position

The Senior Facilities Manager is responsible for the strategic and operational management of the school’s facilities, ensuring a safe, functional, and efficient environment for the school community. This professional coordinates the maintenance, electrical, civil, and operational support teams, as well as the outsourced contracts for gardening and cleaning services, ensuring service quality, meeting deadlines, and controlling costs. They plan and execute preventive and corrective maintenance programs, manage the department’s budget, and ensure the legal compliance of the buildings.


Main Duties and Responsibilities

  • Directly manage the maintenance, electrical, civil, and operational support teams.

title: Analista de planejamento - BI (Supply Chain)
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Principais Atividades:

Mapeamento e crítica dos processos de Supply Chain, bem como nível de manualidade, regras de negócio e indicadores;

Interação com diversos níveis e áreas da companhia;

Mapear os gargalos de dados e processos para tomada de decisão identificando as principais dificuldades de acesso e correlações das informações;

Criação de soluções de automação e inteligência em subprocessos manuais;

Propor produto de dados com foco nas análises para geração de insights, a fim de facilitar a tomada de decisão para ganhos de eficiência por otimização;

Levantamento de práticas nacionais e internacionais de desenvolvimento de produtos, com foco na gestão de dados.


Conhecimentos e habilidades necessários:

Experiência em Supply Chain: planejamento de demanda, planejamento de produção, estoques e/ou atendimento ao cliente;

Formação em Análise de Dados ou áreas correlatas;

Conhecimento intermediário/avançado de ferramentas de análise de dados e/ou de entrega de

relatórios do pacote Google: Google Sheet, GCP, Big Query, Tableau e App Sheet;

Conhecimento desejável em ferramentas e linguagens voltadas à análise de dados (BigQuery ou DataPrep,

SQL, R ou Python).

title: Product Designer
description:
About the Company



Hi, we’re Actabl. We’re providing better solutions for hotel companies as the world around us evolves and changes related to using technology, finding labor, and maximizing profits. Our mission is to empower the people that power hospitality. We give hoteliers actionable insights to know what to do, the tools to do it, and the visibility to know it worked. We bring together powerful hospitality tech solutions to maximize profits for more than 10,000 properties in hospitality markets around the world.



Our Valued Behaviors


  • Start with People: We are in the hospitality business and hospitality starts with people. This impacts both our being and our doing.
  • Being: We are responsible for building relationships, earning trust, and having fun. These things are fundamental to hospitality.
  • Doing: We will succeed if we start with great people working as one team. Empower others, speak the truth with care, and go together.
  • Demand Integrity: Be trustworthy, be ethical, and be consistent whether someone is watching or not. Demand integrity of yourself and others to build the fabric of a high-integrity organization.
  • Delight the Customer: We aim to delight our customers in the same way our customers aim to delight their guests. The question is not if completed a process or hit a metric, the question is whether or not the customer is delighted.
  • Champion Innovation: We compete in the game of change and win through innovation. Think big and then think bigger when it comes to the innovation required to tackle the problems our customers face daily.
  • Make it Happen: We show up prepared, care about the details, and follow through. Don't get distracted. Don't stop at blockers. Don't make excuses. Find a way and drive until it is done.



About Actabl's Product Design Team


We redefine expectations

We treat SaaS with the same passion and craft you’d expect from world-class consumer products. Our mission is to redefine what hospitality teams can expect from their tools by delivering thoughtful, high-quality experiences and pushing the product forward step by step, with real impact.


Bellhop Design System

Our young design system is called Bellhop because it was inspired by the essence of hospitality. It's a scalable and cohesive system made to empower people who power hospitality. Check out Actabl Design here .



Key Responsibilities:

  • Own end-to-end design across features and flows, from discovery to delivery.
  • Collaborate with PMs and engineers to shape problem spaces, define requirements, and validate solutions.
  • Design intuitive, scalable interfaces for enterprise SaaS products with heavy use of dashboards, complex data tables, and operational workflows .
  • Run user interviews, synthesize insights, and convert them into actionable design decisions.
  • Produce high-quality UI/UX deliverables: journeys, wireframes, flows, high-fidelity screens, prototypes, tables, dashboards, etc.
  • Work closely with our design system team to maintain consistency and push our standards forward.
  • Advocate for user experience and influence decision-making across cross-functional teams.
  • Incorporate AI tools, Vibe Coding, and rapid prototyping into your process to increase velocity and quality.
  • Understand our products, personas, their journeys, and JTBD.



You as a Product Designer

Ideal Profile


You are not a “by the books” Product Designer and have at least 3 years of experience, strong design craft, and excellent communication skills. You are comfortable with high-density enterprise SaaS interfaces such as dashboards and data grids, and you work confidently with design systems and cross-functional teams.


  • 3+ years of experience as a Product Designer (UX/UI) in tech or SaaS companies.
  • Portuguese and English is mandatory
  • Living in Brazil.
  • Strong product thinking, ability to break down complexity, understand constraints, frame problems, and propose pragmatic solutions.
  • Excellent English communication (major stakeholders are native english speakers)
  • Solid experience designing for enterprise SaaS applications.
  • Comfortable crafting elegant high-density interfaces.
  • Experience working with design systems (tokens, components, libraries).
  • Strong craft with an attention to detail.
  • Portfolio demonstrating clear thinking, strong fundamentals, and high-quality craft.'


Nice to Have

  • Experience with AI prototyping tools (e.g., Figma Make, V0, Claude Code).
  • Experience integrating AI into design workflows.
  • Familiarity with hospitality, operational tools, or B2B workflows.



Work Environment:

Location: Full-remote Brasil.

Connectivity: Requires a reliable internet connection and a suitable home office setup.

Equipment: The company provides necessary equipment (laptop, monitor, peripherals).

Travel: Occasional travel may be required. A valid driver's license may be required for travel.

Work Hours: Employees are expected to be available during core business hours to ensure collaboration with team members and stakeholders.

Communication: Regular communication via video calls, chat applications, and email is expected.


Additional Information

  • Full-remote job position
  • You will be hired as a contractor (PJ)

title: Cientista de dados
description:
Buscamos um Cientista de Dados Sênior com profundo foco em estatística e metodologia quantitativa para se juntar à nossa equipe. O profissional será responsável por liderar a aplicação de técnicas estatísticas robustas na análise de dados complexos, transformando grandes volumes de informação em insights estratégicos e modelos preditivos de alta precisão. Esta função é crucial para garantir a validade científica e a interpretabilidade de todas as nossas soluções de dados.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Modelagem Estatística: Projetar, desenvolver e validar modelos estatísticos (regressão, séries temporais, modelos lineares generalizados, etc.) e algoritmos de Machine Learning para resolver problemas de negócio complexos.
  • Análise Preditiva e Prescritiva: Liderar análises aprofundadas usando técnicas estatísticas para previsão de tendências, segmentação de clientes, otimização de processos e avaliação de risco.
  • Teste de Hipóteses e Experimentação (A/B Testing): Conduzir o design de experimentos (DOE) e realizar testes A/B rigorosos, aplicando testes de significância estatística para medir o impacto e a eficácia de novas funcionalidades ou estratégias.
  • Validação e Interpretabilidade: Garantir a validade estatística dos modelos e resultados, focando na interpretabilidade para que as descobertas sejam claramente comunicadas e acionáveis para as equipes de produto e executivas.
  • Manipulação e Limpeza de Dados: Trabalhar com big data , realizar ETL (Extract, Transform, Load ) e garantir a qualidade dos dados utilizados nas análises.
  • Comunicação de Insights : Traduzir resultados estatísticos complexos em narrativas de negócio claras, utilizando visualizações de dados eficazes e relatórios detalhados para stakeholders não-técnicos.

Requisitos Essenciais

  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas quantitativas correlatas. Pós-graduação (Mestrado/Doutorado) em Estatística, Econometria ou Métodos Quantitativos é um diferencial.
  • Estatística Avançada: Domínio de métodos estatísticos, inferência, econometria, amostragem e teste de hipóteses.
  • Programação: Proficiência em Python ou R para análise de dados, estatística e desenvolvimento de modelos.
  • Bancos de Dados: Experiência com SQL para manipulação e extração de dados.
  • Experiência: Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência comprovada como Cientista de Dados ou em função quantitativa similar.

Habilidades Desejáveis

  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados (Tableau, Power BI, Looker Studio ).
  • Familiaridade com Deep Learning e modelos de linguagem (LLMs ).
